summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from naming the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: On state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: switch in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track; holds the native input stretched over it and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, transparent over the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob, decorative (aria-hidden); start edge when off, end edge when on (mirrors in RTL).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary; thumb moves to the end edge.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins (ElementInternals): setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked state (the checked attribute), formStateRestoreCallback restores checked, a disabled fieldset disables it without touching the disabled attribute, disabled is not submitted, <label for> on the host toggles it.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20px (sm 24x16px); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009)

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox input; aria-checked follows the native checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes the thumb and track transitions
announcements: screen readers announce on/off from role=switch on each toggle (native)
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single on/off setting, such as a preference in a settings form
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label that names the setting

useCases.when: The effect of turning it on needs explaining
The setting must be on before the form submits
useCases.use: required with a label that states what is being enabled

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that only takes effect when a form is confirmed and reads as agreement (terms, consent)
antiPatterns.why: The visual reference and the APG present a switch as an on/off setting; agreement reads as a checkbox

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a toolbar formatting state (bold, italic)
antiPatterns.why: That is a pressed button, not an on/off setting

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("On" / "Off")
antiPatterns.why: The APG switch pattern keeps the label constant; the state is conveyed by role=switch
antiPatterns.alternative: A constant label that names the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn's bg-input is neutral-200; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
shadcn uses 1.15rem (18.4px); rounded to the size scale
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern (native checkbox with role=switch), the visual reference's look and two sizes, label row beside the switch like Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, or a <button role=switch aria-checked>?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: native checkbox input with role=switch. It gives Space, validity (required -> valueMissing) and checked state for free and reuses FormAssociated + NativeControl like Checkbox (SB-0007: native elements first).

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle (APG optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: Enter submits the form, like the native control and Checkbox (SB-0009). Only Space toggles, which is the APG's required key.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and what are they called?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: size="default" | "sm", the visual reference's values, mapped to the canonical medium/small like Avatar and Card. Dimensions come from the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no, as in Checkbox. The attribute is the default that form reset restores (like native defaultChecked).

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and where does it sit?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: required, after the switch in the same row (Checkbox layout); hide-label keeps it as the accessible name. Putting the switch at the end of the row is left to a later Field orientation, not a Switch prop.

openQuestions.question: Indeterminate state or on/off icons in the thumb?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: neither. A switch has no mixed state in the APG and the visual reference draws a plain thumb (YAGNI).
